descByPlatform.chatgpt: Wide-Angle Charity Run Poster for RUN FOR HOPE 5K 10K Half Central Park. Subject: silhouetted runner in mid-stride at 32% x, 58-90% y against Golden Hour sky gradient #E8A55C top fading to #D84B2B horizon, foreground rim-lit wild grass #8B7E6E at 0-22% y swaying camera-left, long purple cast shadow trailing camera-right. Composition: Rule of Thirds runner 32% x 70% y, Centered 50% x hero vertical, low horizon at 60% y, AR 2:3. Camera: Phase One XF IQ4 150MP, Schneider 35mm LS at f/8, 1/500s, ISO 200, tripod. Lighting: Golden Hour Backlit Sun + Rim — sun disc behind runner 4m (key rim silhouette), 4×4ft silver bounce camera-right 1.5m (fill), 6×6ft diffusion scrim overhead to soften sky falloff, 4×4ft black flag to deepen foreground grass. Material physics: grass rim-light translucency, heat shimmer distortion, atmospheric haze. Typography: 'RUN FOR HOPE · 5K · 10K · HALF' 78pt Bebas Neue cream #F4ECD8 centred 50% x 22% y; subhead 'APRIL 30 · CENTRAL PARK · REGISTER APRIL-15.ORG' 14pt Inter tracking-250 #F4ECD8 centred 50% x 86% y. Color grade: DaVinci Golden-Hour-Warm LUT grain 10 +0.1 EV. Palette: sky #E8A55C 34%, horizon #D84B2B 22%, grass #8B7E6E 14%, silhouette black 16%, cream type #F4ECD8 14%. References: Saul Bass Olympic, Nike vintage, LIFE magazine sports. Exclude: flat blue sky, vector logo, CGI gloss, harsh flash, daylight spill.
